0022600109.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 1-1 and ranked 9th in the West, host the 0-2 San Antonio Spurs, who are 12th in the West, in the Mavericks' third game of the season. Dallas will be without Cooper Flagg (shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), while Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, after Dallas lost 0-4 to San Antonio in the 2025-26 season series, including a 139-120 loss in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
